name: Tastiella de Lu
original_name: タスティエーラ・デ・ルゥ
source:
As the oldest person in Em Pheyna, she is a well respected woman, and always consulted by Flute before he does anything big. She is quiet and seems like she has insight to everything.

[Edited from [url=http://nisamerica.com/games/artonelico/]Ar Tonelico Official Site[/url] and [url=http://artonelico.isisview.org/wiki/index.php/Settei_book_translations/Characters_section#Tastiella_De_Lu]A Reyvateil's Memory Wiki[/url]]

[spoiler]Tastiella was originally a high priestess of Em Pheyna during the Second Era. According to Shurelia, she sacrificed herself in order to seal Mir. She now acts as the Crescent Chronicle's terminal to oversee the physical world and therefore can only move within Em Pheyna and the Crescent Chronicle. Her "body" is severely damaged later in the game, but she manages to oversee the end of Lyner's journey and congratulate him, before bidding farewell and disappearing, thus dying as she wished.

[From [url=http://artonelico.wikia.com/wiki/Tastiella_De_Lu]Ar Tonelico Wiki[/url]][/spoiler]
